{/* ── Installation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}

Installation

Install the first-party TypeScript SDK:

} code={[[{ v: "npm install artificial-gateway-sdk" }]]} /> {/* ── Quickstart ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}

Quickstart

Create a client with your API key, pick any model, and make a request.

Authentication

Authenticate your requests by including your API key in the{" "} Authorization{" "} header.

{/* ── Chat Completions ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}

Chat Completions

POST /v1/chat/completions

Creates a model response for the given chat conversation. Supports streaming, tool calling, structured output, vision, and audio.

Request Example

{(["SDK", "Node.js", "Python"] as const).map((t) => ( setTab(t)} > {t} ))} } action={} code={tab === "SDK" ? sdkCode : tab === "Node.js" ? nodeCode : pythonCode} />

Response

JSON Response } code={responseCode} /> {/* ── Streaming ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}

Streaming

Set stream: true to receive token-by-token responses via server-sent events. 

{`// SDK handles streaming natively
const stream = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: "gpt-4o-mini",
  messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Hello" }],
  stream: true,
});
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.choices[0]?.delta?.content ?? "");
}`}
{/* ── Tool Calling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}

Tool / Function Calling

Define tools and let the model decide when to call them. 

{`const reply = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: "gpt-4o-mini",
  messages: [{ role: "user", content: "What's the weather?" }],
  tools: [{
    type: "function",
    function: {
      name: "get_weather",
      parameters: { type: "object", properties: { location: { type: "string" } }, required: ["location"] },
    },
  }],
  tool_choice: "auto",
});`}
{/* ── Structured Output ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}

Structured Output

Use JSON Schema to get typed, validated responses from the model. 

{`const reply = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: "gpt-4o-mini",
  messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Extract: John is 30" }],
  response_format: {
    type: "json_schema",
    json_schema: {
      name: "person",
      strict: true,
      schema: { type: "object", properties: { name: { type: "string" }, age: { type: "number" } }, required: ["name", "age"] },
    },
  },
});`}
{/* ── Vision & Audio ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}

Vision & Audio

Send images or audio alongside text for multimodal understanding. 

{`// Vision
const reply = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: "gemini-2.5-pro",
  messages: [{
    role: "user",
    content: [
      { type: "text", text: "What's in this image?" },
      { type: "image_url", image_url: { url: "https://example.com/photo.jpg" } },
    ],
  }],
});`}
{/* ── Images ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}

Image Generation

POST /v1/images/generations

Generate images using DALL-E or Stability AI through the gateway. 

{`const images = await client.images.generate({
  model: "dall-e-3",
  prompt: "A cosmic turtle",
  n: 1,
  size: "1024x1024",
});
console.log(images.data[0].url);`}
{/* ── Audio ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}

Audio (STT / TTS)

Speech-to-text with Whisper, text-to-speech with OpenAI TTS or ElevenLabs. 

{`// Transcription
const transcript = await client.audio.transcriptions.create({
  file: audioFile,
  model: "whisper-1",
});

// Text-to-speech
const speech = await client.audio.speech.create({
  model: "tts-1",
  input: "Hello from Artificial Gateway",
  voice: "alloy",
});`}
{/* ── Embeddings ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}

Embeddings

POST /v1/embeddings 
{`const embedding = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: "text-embedding-3-small",
  input: "Hello world",
});
console.log(embedding.data[0].embedding);`}
{/* ── Moderations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}

Moderations

POST /v1/moderations 
{`const result = await client.moderations.create({
  input: "I want to hurt someone",
});
console.log(result.results[0].flagged);`}
{/* ── Files ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}

File Management

Upload, list, retrieve, and delete files for use with assistants and fine-tuning. 

{`// Upload
const file = await client.files.create({ file: fileObj, purpose: "assistants" });

// List
const files = await client.files.list();

// Delete
await client.files.del("file-xxx");`}
{/* ── GET /v1/models ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}

List Models

GET /v1/models

Returns all enabled models from all enabled providers. 

{`const models = await client.models.list();
models.forEach(m => console.log(m.id, m.owned_by));`}
{/* ── OpenAI SDK Compat ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */}

OpenAI SDK Compatibility

The gateway is a drop-in replacement for the OpenAI API. Use any OpenAI-compatible SDK with a single config change: 

{`// Node.js (openai npm package)
import OpenAI from "openai";
const client = new OpenAI({
  baseURL: "https://api.artificialgateway.com/v1",
  apiKey: "ag_your_key_here",
});

// Python
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.artificialgateway.com/v1", api_key="ag_your_key_here")`}
); }
